name: Tempester n°36: per-pad play probability for the sequencer (CC 14, saved in the beat)
explanation: Before: every note of the sequencer played. Now each pad of each beat has a play probability p (0-100 %, default 100 = stock behaviour bit for bit). When [routine] (Timer 4) reaches a note due on this tick whose pad is playing (pad state 0), it reads the pad's drop d = 100 - p at [address] + beat * 32 + pad; d = 0 queues the note as before (no draw); otherwise an LCG in [address] (x = (x + Count) * 1664525 + 1013904223, pct = ((x >> 16) * 100) >> 16) skips the note when pct < d: a skipped note is never queued, so no voice, no MIDI note-on, nothing to release or choke (hook [address], code 0x9d07d600). Storage: the 512 bytes [address]-[address] are the flasher's row buffer (only 3 address loads, all in the flasher page, which runs once an OS update has been received and never returns); [address] has no access anywhere in 1.5.0.2 or 1.6.2.0; both .bss (zero at boot = 100 %). File: pad block word 5 of the beat header (written 0, never read by the stock OS; 0 in all 256 factory beats) now carries d: [routine] writes it, [routine] reads it in modes 0-1 with the other pad fields ([address]; d > 100 read as 0); one serializer pair for beat files, project files and the SysEx 5F / 5C n, so all keep it, and an older OS ignores it. Init Beat ([routine], tail call [address]) resets the beat's 32 drops. Edit: MIDI CC 14 (its entry [address] in the CC 12-27 jump table went to the default case), value = p in percent (101-127 = 100) on the Remote Pad IN channel, for the selected pad of the beat being edited, main loop only. No screen shows the value. Copy and Undo/Compare do not carry it. Every routine is a leaf without stack. Docs/analyses/feature-step-probability.md.

edits.why: j 0x9d07d600 ; [routine], gate of a note due on this tick: was "lui a0,0xa000" (redone in ROLL); delay slot "sll v1,a1,0x3" kept (v1 = (beat*0x30 + pad)*8)

jal 0x9d07d674 ; [routine], pad loop: was "sh zero,0x0(a3)" (pad block word 5 = 0), stored by SER; delay slot "lbu a2,0x82(t7)" kept; ra (a temporary here, last read at [address], rewritten at [address]) = [address]
jal 0x9d07d69c ; [routine], pad loop (mode < 2): was "sb v0,0x3(t3)" (mixer byte 3), redone in DES; delay slot "lhu s8,0xa(a2)" kept; ra (temporary, last read at [address]) = [address]
j 0x9d07d6d0 ; [routine], end: was "j [address]" (tail call, a0 = beat), made by INIT; delay slot "addiu sp,sp,0x30" kept
lui a0,0xa000 ; replaced instruction. Live: s5 = beat, v0 = pad ([routine], & 0x1f), v1 = (beat*0x30 + pad)*8
original [address] | original [address]: pad record [address] + (beat*0x30 + pad)*8 - 0x80 | original [address]: play state (0 plays, 2 muted or out of solo, 3 volume 0)
bne a3,zero,0x9d07d66c ; not playing: skipped as before, nothing drawn
sltiu t2,s5,0x10 ; delay slot: beat < 16 (the table has 16 beats)
beq t2,zero,0x9d07d66c ; beat 16 or more: plays, as before
lbu t3,0x7660(t3) ; d = drop in percent, [address] + beat * 32 + pad
beq t3,zero,0x9d07d66c ; d = 0 (100 %, the default): plays, a3 = 0, the stock path
lw t4,0x25c(a0) ; delay slot (harmless when taken): PRNG state [address]
mfc0 t5,Count ; core timer: timing entropy
srl t4,t4,0x10 ; high 16 bits (the good ones of an LCG)
sltu a3,t4,t3 ; a3 = 1 (skip) when pct < d, else 0 (play)
j [address] ; back to "bnel a3,zero,[address]": a3 != 0 skips the note (next slot), a3 = 0 queues it; t2-t5 are rewritten before any read on both paths
sltiu v1,s3,0x10 ; Live: s3 = beat (move s3,a0 at [address]), t2 = pad, a3 = address of word 5. v1, t8, t9 dead (rewritten at [address], [address], [address])
or t8,zero,zero ; delay slot: 0 for a beat outside the table (stock value)
lbu t8,0x7660(t8) ; d of this pad
sh t8,0x0(a3) ; delay slot: pad block word 5 = d (0 = 100 %, the stock word)

replaced instruction. Live: s6 = beat, t4 = pad, a2 = address of word 1 of the pad block, t9 = [address] (loop base). v1, t0, a0 dead (rewritten before any read on every path, as n°13 found for a0 and t0)
beq t0,zero,0x9d07d6c8 ; beat outside the table: nothing stored
lhu v1,0x8(a2) ; delay slot: pad block word 5 = d
movz v1,zero,t0 ; d > 100: not a value this patch writes, read as 0 (100 %)
sltiu t0,a0,0x10 ; a0 = beat (move a0,s5 at [address]), argument of the tail call
sw zero,0x7660(t0) ; the 32 drops of this beat = 0 (100 %)
j [address] ; the replaced tail call, a0 unchanged
sltiu t0,a2,0x65 ; CC 14 (jump table entry [address]). Live: a2 = value & 0xff, channel already accepted (Remote Pad IN), s8 = UI object; ra is a temporary here (the epilogue at [address] reloads it)
lw t2,-0x7a2c(gp) ; beat being edited, [address] (UI object + 0x13C), as the knobs and n°9a
lbu t3,-0x7b16(gp) ; delay slot: selected pad, [address] (UI object + 0x52)
j [address] ; the default case, as before for CC 14: "b [address] / clear a1" (return 0)

.word 0x9d07d70c ; CC 12-27 jump table ([address], [routine] event 10), entry of CC 14: was [address] (default case, no effect), now CCPROB (data word, added by the build: asm_resolve.py has no .word)
